notes: Protocol fixed before new stress or external forecast scores; no hyperparameter search or corruption-aware refit.
Existing local evaluation windows are exposed diagnostics, not new independent confirmation.

Frozen joint five-sensor model cannot be validly zero-shot evaluated on single-CO2 datasets. External evaluation tests a univariate TCN method and its source-to-target transfer, not the frozen deployment weights.
External datasets use only CO2; no occupancy labels or derived CO2 slope. Five-minute right-closed latest-observation bins, 900s causal freshness; no target filling or cross-gap interpolation.
External timestamps lack verified timezone. Calendar inputs fixed to zero; naive timestamps represented on a nominal epoch only for ordering and intervals.
Local input corruption never changes truth. Compare corrupted persistence and clean model on the identical accepted origins; report rejection/coverage separately.
Full history outages rejected by the current inference contract are failures of availability, not successful forecasts. No untested fallback is silently enabled.
All scenarios including adverse results are retained; no universal robustness threshold is claimed.
external_split_basis: Rank of actually observed five-minute bins; boundaries on original unstitched grid, complete 12-step future labels required.
